verdict.rationale: GitHub offers background automation via Actions CI/CD and Copilot coding agent (assign tasks, autonomous PR reviews, autofix, dependency updates) per docs (github-docs-4,5,6,7,9,11), suggesting real support for autonomous background workflows. However, evidence is limited to marketing-level claims with no detailed setup/configuration proof, and community feedback highlights reliability/outage issues (github-comm-1,2,18) that could undermine trust in unattended automation.
